svg.title: راجِع
svg.desc: The same mark as src/brand/Mark.tsx. Colours are LITERAL, not var(--accent): a favicon is fetched outside the document, so it has no stylesheet and no custom properties, and currentColor would render black on every tab. The ink square gives the mark its own ground, because a tab strip may be light or dark and a bare accent stroke disappears into one of them. Any change to Mark.tsx belongs here too. REBRANDED 2026-08-22, gold (#B8862B) → violet (#6a4cf5, config/product.json's brand.accent.light) — this file was missed in that pass; a browser tab kept the old identity after every screen in the product had already moved on.
